selection_rule: Read underlying LAST once; select exact option strike minimizing absolute distance to that value from the returned 2026-11-20 regular SOXX class. If LAST unavailable, stop. Then read the selected call and put quotes once each.
stops: Missing current underlying LAST, contract IDs, quotes, IV or Delta -> record needs_market_data and stop
After-hours, delayed, crossed or stale quotes are not forward decision evidence
No new subscription, order, alert or broker action
